title: Merge freelancer- and self-employed-schedule-c-categorizer into one venture

change: Read both calc.mjs and tests, keep the stronger one, port any rules only the other has, and leave the loser's directory as a pointer or drop it with a redirect page if its URL is published. result: Dropped: both are published pages linked from ~20 files (build.mjs, launched.json, expense-tracker, self-employment-tax-calculator, dental-associate-pay-calculator, scores).
